external_entities.name: customer
external_entities.description: A customer who browses and places orders through the mobile app and receives faxed confirmations.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

external_entities.name: marketing
external_entities.description: The marketing staff who maintain the product catalogue and use spreadsheet macros to change catalogue data through the web API.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Marketing keep the catalogue in a spreadsheet.

processes.name: mobile app
processes.description: The mobile application through which customers browse and order socks.
processes.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

processes.name: web API
processes.description: The API that handles customer data, orders, catalogue changes, and communication with SIMS.
processes.source_excerpt: The web API keeps customers in the user database
processes.notes: Authentication is explicitly unknown: "Nobody here can tell me what the API does about authentication".

processes.name: SIMS
processes.description: The stock and inventory system that receives orders, writes delivery addresses, and sends dispatch notes.
processes.source_excerpt: SIMS does two things with an order.

processes.name: fax gateway
processes.description: The gateway that sends dispatch confirmations by fax to the number stored against an order.
processes.source_excerpt: it sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway

processes.name: spreadsheet macros
processes.description: Macros in the marketing spreadsheet that send SQL statements to the web API to change prices and product copy.
processes.source_excerpt: The macros in it send SQL statements straight to the web API to change prices and product copy

data_stores.name: user database
data_stores.description: The database containing customer names, addresses, and the card they paid with.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The web API keeps customers in the user database: name, address, and the card they paid with.
data_stores.notes: Encryption at rest is explicitly unknown: "Nobody here can tell me ... whether the user database ... [is] encrypted."

data_stores.name: flat file
data_stores.description: A flat file containing delivery addresses only.
data_stores.source_excerpt: It writes the delivery address into a flat file kept alongside it — only addresses go in that file, nothing else
data_stores.notes: Encryption at rest is explicitly unknown: "Nobody here can tell me ... whether ... the flat file [is] encrypted."

data_stores.name: spreadsheet
data_stores.description: The marketing catalogue spreadsheet containing catalogue data used by macros to change prices and product copy.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Marketing keep the catalogue in a spreadsheet.

data_flows.name: browse and order
data_flows.description: Customer browsing and ordering through the mobile app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

data_flows.name: talks to
data_flows.description: The mobile app communicates with the web API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app talks to the web API over HTTP — not HTTPS

data_flows.name: keeps customers
data_flows.description: The web API stores customer records in the user database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The web API keeps customers in the user database
data_flows.data_description: Customer name, address, and payment card information

data_flows.name: hands order
data_flows.description: The web API sends an order to SIMS.
data_flows.source_excerpt: When an order is placed the API hands the order over to SIMS

data_flows.name: writes address
data_flows.description: SIMS writes the delivery address to the flat file.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It writes the delivery address into a flat file

data_flows.name: sends dispatch note
data_flows.description: SIMS sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway.
data_flows.source_excerpt: it sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway
data_flows.data_description: Dispatch note containing the customer's name and address

data_flows.name: faxes confirmation
data_flows.description: The fax gateway faxes a confirmation to the customer.
data_flows.source_excerpt: which faxes the customer a confirmation with their name and address on it
data_flows.notes: The text says nobody checks that the fax arrived at the right place.
data_flows.data_description: Confirmation containing the customer's name and address

data_flows.name: keeps catalogue
data_flows.description: Marketing maintains the catalogue in the spreadsheet.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Marketing keep the catalogue in a spreadsheet.
data_flows.data_description: Product catalogue, prices, and product copy

data_flows.name: changes catalogue
data_flows.description: Spreadsheet macros send SQL statements to the web API to change prices and product copy.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The macros in it send SQL statements straight to the web API to change prices and product copy
data_flows.data_description: SQL statements changing prices and product copy

trust_boundaries.name: office
trust_boundaries.description: The office location where the marketing laptop hosting the spreadsheet is located.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The spreadsheet lives on a marketing laptop in the office.

assumptions.assumption: The web API is reachable from the internet because Sokify sells socks online and customers use the mobile app to browse and order.
assumptions.basis: The system is described as selling online to customers through a mobile app, and the mobile app communicates with the web API.

assumptions.assumption: The user database contains confidential data because it stores customer names, addresses, and payment card information.
assumptions.basis: The stated contents are personal and payment data.

assumptions.assumption: The flat file contains confidential data because it stores customer delivery addresses.
assumptions.basis: The stated contents are personal address data.

assumptions.assumption: The spreadsheet contains confidential data because it stores commercially sensitive catalogue prices and product copy.
assumptions.basis: The spreadsheet is the marketing catalogue and is used to change prices and product copy.
